summary: Entire original P12.4 remains unresolved: higher-dimensional independent Cartier comparison and actual locality are not proved. Complete partial-proof deliverables are retained; candidate=false.
detailedSummary: Records the proved algebraic kernel, actual bounded moment extension, gauge/normalization rules, published smooth comparison and actual geometric zero-arity curve case. Separately identifies the missing higher-dimensional geometric comparison and open-region locality arguments. No impossibility theorem for reduced P12.4, energy theorem or general finite-map calculus is claimed. Compilation and finite/hash audits establish artifact consistency only.
text:
The ENTIRE original P12.4 is not solved. Candidate=false.

The draft establishes an algebraic mixed-multiplicity kernel at every excellent reduced local ring, a unique positive moment-measure extension to real C inputs and bounded inputs in G331's ACTUAL decreasing completion D, a weak descending-net theorem with specified bounded-D limit, exact primary-gauge and residue-degree normalization identities, and equality with the exact published BFJ operator in its smooth affine CLOSED-germ algebraically closed characteristic-zero range. All supports and full conductor fibres are retained. Zero and mixed-zero inputs are admitted when in the actual class; unbounded and bottom inputs are excluded. Non-equidimensional rings use the explicit degree-n convention with n−1 potentials.

An actual independent geometric theorem is proved for all excellent reduced curves: the zero-potential reference measure, real Cartier zero-cycle comparison on actual primary models, model independence, exact gauge/normalization weights, and locality/continuity at zero arity. Dimension zero has empty boundary and zero measure. The nilpotent obstruction concerns only reconstruction of unreduced lengths from reduced data.

Two higher-dimensional obligations remain unresolved. First, prove that the extended kernel agrees with an independently defined local Cartier intersection for every actual negative curve-nef REAL Cartier presentation on an actual primary blowup, retaining nonnormal, non-Cohen–Macaulay, finite-residue-field and non-equidimensional issues. G331's uniform FUNCTION approximation does not establish INTERSECTION continuity. Uniform approximation by section-ideal evaluations does not by itself identify their multiplicities with an independent Euler-characteristic intersection. No arbitrary-model cofinality is available.

Second, prove actual open-set locality: if every pair u_i,w_i agrees on an open U in the normalized boundary, prove equality of the restrictions of their mixed measures to U. Positivity, global length polynomials, uniqueness of moment representation and weak convergence do not prove this. Even a core model-atom locality argument would need a further valid passage to arbitrary bounded completed inputs; neither step is supplied here. The diagnostic in n6 demonstrates the inadequacy of the bare formal properties, without disproving locality of the actual kernel.

Accordingly n3's measures are called MOMENT measures and are not promoted to the requested actual geometric products. Algebraic presentation independence is not relabelled geometric model-independent intersection theory. Missing proofs are not an impossibility verdict for reduced P12.4. P12.5 energy and general P12.6 operators remain separate.

Deliverables produced in the workspace are P12.4-paper.tex and P12.4-paper.pdf, argument.md, source-application-ledger.md, exact-scope.md, whole-proof-coverage.md, original-scope-and-noncircularity-decision.md, native-notes.json, n1.md through n7.md, bounded-evidence-input.json, and the fresh scripts audit_inputs.py, exact_diagnostics.py, build_delivery.py and final_audit.py. Exact authorized mathematical/primary bodies and manifests are retained under inputs; reports retain source URLs, paths and hashes, declared reading units, environment details, finite observations, build commands/output and own file bindings. The qualified G331 source, mandatory annotation and ledger remain unchanged.

Observed artifact evidence: the 15-page PDF compiled successfully; final cross-reference warnings were resolved, with three underfull-box formatting diagnostics retained in the log. The final artifact/support audit returned PASS for seven notes and 31 bound inputs. The finite diagnostic counts and domains are n6's observations. These checks establish reproducibility and internal artifact consistency, not mathematical correctness or independent acceptance.

Rerun from the workspace: python audit_inputs.py; python exact_diagnostics.py; python build_delivery.py; python final_audit.py. Compilation uses pdflatex with no shell escape. No supplied executable was executed or imported. No agents, active private campaign output reads, hot feedback, authentication/runtime/environment/HOME/CODEX_HOME/proxy/CA changes, publication, catalogue mutation or protected-editor interaction were used. No supervised heavy-compute facility was supplied or needed, and no heavy computation was launched. The caller's requested model designation is not independently attested.

All mathematical claims remain unverified drafts. Candidate=false specifically because independent higher-dimensional Cartier comparison and actual locality remain unproved; successful compilation, hashes and finite diagnostics cannot discharge them.
